title: Online match settings
description: data/netcode/online.json: how online matches run (developer settings). They don't change game results, so they are not part of the data hash or the match rules. Editor aid only: Sim.Data's validator is authoritative (src/Sim.Data/Online).

rollbackFrames.description: Rollback window (ADR-0003): the most frames predicted ahead of the other player's last confirmed input, and so the most frames one rollback re-runs. When the other player's inputs are older than this, the game waits for them instead. Default 8.

automaticInputDelay.description: How the automatic input delay follows Backdash's ping (ADR-0005 §4). The delay is recalculated only between rounds, from the median of the newest readings. A player's override (options menu) replaces it.

minimumFrames.description: Delay at the lowest ping. Default 1.

maximumFrames.description: Highest automatic delay, at least minimumFrames; also the first round's delay, before any ping is known. Default 2.

pingStepMilliseconds.description: Each full step of this much median ping (Backdash's, ~20 ms above Steam's: ADR-0014 problem 4) adds one frame above minimumFrames. Default 50.

pingSampleIntervalFrames.description: Logic frames between two ping readings. Default 60 (one a second).

pingSamples.description: Newest readings the median covers, so one spike or one too-low reading never sets the delay. Default 15.

disconnect.description: When a silent connection is warned about and ends the match (ADR-0005 §4). Silence means no packet at all from the other PC; a connection that comes back before the end resumes the match.

warningAfterMilliseconds.description: Silence before the "connection interrupted" warning, with the seconds left. At least 250, above Backdash's 200 ms keep-alive. Default 3000.

endMatchAfterMilliseconds.description: Silence before the match ends without a result; more than warningAfterMilliseconds. Default 10000.
